purpose: HSPICE .pz v(out) vin drives the named source and finds poles and zeros.

oracle.derivation: ngspice on the same circuit with `.pz in 0 out 0 vol pz`.

confirmed.derivation: Linear MNA of the deck (numpy), sources zeroed: poles are the finite generalized eigenvalues of (G, -C); zeros those of the transfer system bordered by the input excitation and the output probe (scipy.linalg.eig). Poles -1893149.824 and -440183.509 rad/s, zeros -750000 +- 2106537.443j rad/s. Xyce has no .pz.
